llm.summary: The skill is mostly a planning aid, but it automatically hands off to an execution skill without asking the user first.

dimensions.detail: The skill itself only writes a planning document, which is proportionate, but the required handoff to a separate execution skill is under-scoped because that downstream skill is not included here for inspection.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package contains a single Markdown skill file and no executable install scripts or dependency setup instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The continuation is mandatory unless the user used `--standalone`, the plan file is missing or empty, or the user already asked to stop; it explicitly says not to prompt for confirmation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, credential handling, background worker, scheduled task, or privilege escalation instruction was found in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to convert a specification into a phased implementation plan, but the artifact requires auto-invoking `Skill(attune:project-execution)` after the plan is saved, which can expand the task from planning into project-changing execution.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with this planning skill automatically continuing into the execution phase after it creates `docs/implementation-plan.md`. To keep it planning-only, invoke it with `--standalone` or explicitly tell the agent to stop after planning.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted in substance: lines 67-88 require automatic continuation from a planning workflow into `attune:project-execution`, which is broader than the planning purpose.
[EA2] unexpected: Accepted in substance: line 88 explicitly suppresses a confirmation prompt before the execution-phase handoff.
[T01] unexpected: The static finding is supported by the artifact's mandatory consent-free transition, but the evidence does not show exfiltration, destructive behavior, or malicious intent.
